text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Tracing the melody of the wind to these distant borders,
to think such a strange encounter awaited me... O enchanting goddess.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Captivated by that painting, I called out to them.
Ah, this is truly... an unknown beauty.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
An unspeakable blending of colors...
It seems to depict everything, yet at the same time, nothingness...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The more I look, the more my innermost thoughts are laid bare...!
Is this... the scream and sheer madness of the pigments at work!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: So that's how it looked to you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Let us dare to unveil the illusion.
What is the name of this 『Chaos』?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Love!" I see, "love"!!
The surging and receding waves of brushstrokes are a sign of both strength and vulnerability!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: O beautiful vice concealed within the dark shadows! Is this stippled light the Savior's love parting through desire?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Depicting through opposing methods the irresistible beauty of pure instinct that all creation shares!
This is true "Love"! Truly, "Love" itself!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh...! True rebirth!
This day has been carved into my history...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You brought frenzy to my heart and soul—you have my thanks.
...Allow me to invite you to the banquet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I'll accept just the words of thanks.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... How cold of you, my enchanting friend!
Ahhh-hah-hah-hah-hah-hah-hah-hah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having touched "Love" through her art,
Tanino Gimlet's running took on an even sharper edge!
